bullets: Added a ChatGPT BYOK provider that lets you run agents on a personal ChatGPT plan without an API key.
Added a web research helper that searches the internet and reports findings on desktop and web.
Added the ability to rename cloud-based projects.
Changed the free-tier small-request exemption to require both the agent ID and model to match.
Added a promotional price badge to Solar Mini 4 and labeled both Solar models for AI training.
Started saving chat records for Solar Pro 4 and Solar Mini 4 to improve the models.
Changed GLM 5.3 Flash to display a promotional price badge in the model picker.
Updated the country availability notice to include a link that confirms your location.
Closed a security gap that allowed users to bypass free-tier model limits using provider tags.
Changed the support and feedback email addresses to use the freebuff.com domain.
Stopped the command-line tool from sending login details as browser cookies.
Added automatic recovery for interrupted AI responses routed through the main service.
Changed the profile survey snooze times to an escalating ladder ending in a permanent stop.
Updated the profile survey to drop technology questions and add five new ones.
Added read-only access to your Node toolchain so sponsored tasks can find your tools.
Added step counts, time estimates, and user input needs to sponsored offer cards.
Changed sponsored tasks to show a distinct warning when they are waiting for your input.
Added a warning that notifies you if your computer is missing tools required for a sponsored task.
Added the groundwork for advertisers to automatically provide ready-to-use account keys.
Added sponsored surveys to the command-line assistant when standard questions are unavailable.
Added a preflight check that blocks false service integration reports from the AI assistant.
Added a reminder that checks for unreported service integrations before the assistant finishes a task.
Added a check that verifies your computer has the necessary runtimes before accepting sponsored tasks.
